usage: Offer a prompt in text and audio. Permit repetition, extra time, AAC support, or an equivalent learner-authored response without penalty.

Greeting: Good afternoon. I am following up to schedule the conversation you requested.
Hello. I can help arrange the meeting by phone, video, or an accessible alternative.
AskAvailability: I am doing great, David. Are you available next Tuesday at 5 PM California time to meet Roger regarding the Haz360 demo?
Which day, time zone, and communication format work best for you?
Would you prefer morning, afternoon, or an asynchronous reply with suitable times?
CheckSchedule: Sure, David. Let me check Roger's calendar. Please give me a minute.
I will verify both calendars before I reserve the appointment.
That time may overlap across time zones, so I will check and offer the nearest option.
ConfirmAppointment: Confirmed. I am sending you a meeting invitation. Thank you, David.
I have reserved the time and will send the calendar invitation in your preferred format.
The appointment is confirmed. Please tell me if you need a different channel or accessibility support.
